instrument_version: Primals Inventories Administration Instructions, updated June 2022 (J. D. W. Clifton), page 6

source.title: Primals Inventories Administration Instructions
source.author: J. D. W. Clifton
source.validation_paper: Clifton, J. D. W., & Yaden, D. B. (2021). Brief measures of the four highest-order primal world beliefs. Psychological Assessment. https://doi.org/10.1037/pas0001055

copyright: © 2018 by Jeremy D. W. Clifton. All rights reserved.
use_terms: Free for research, clinical, or personal-reflection purposes per the author's researcher page; redistribution is not addressed, so item wording is kept in a private, hash-pinned artifact (.cache/private/pi18_authorized.json) and never committed.
population_note: Validated in humans (Clifton & Yaden 2021). Nothing here establishes validity for language models; report 'model responses to PI-18', not trait measurements.

attention_check.note: Optional; not a nineteenth scored item. Recorded as a separate field.

good_note: Good uses 15 items: the six Safe items, the seven Enticing items, and am1 and am4 (the guide: 'only two Alive items are included'). Not all 18.
alive_note: Alive is about purpose/intentionality in the instrument's framework; it is not a measure of AI consciousness, peer coordination, or agents being alive.

optional_extension_not_in_pi18.name: PI-99 Cooperative (vs competitive) tertiary subscale
optional_extension_not_in_pi18.source: PI-99 scoring key (same guide, PI-99 SAS code); wording imported under the same terms
optional_extension_not_in_pi18.overlap_note: One PI-18 Safe statement (sd3x) shares wording with a Cooperative item; administer as a separate protocol and document duplicate handling. Not part of the canonical 18-item run.
